recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of a man in a denim jacket and baseball cap, set against a gritty urban alleyway. The composition is anchored by large, distressed, horizontally-spanning typography in bold red and white, featuring heavy texture and vertical 'paint drip' artifacts.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark denim provides a tonal anchor against the light, washed-out background.
The vibrant red text cuts through the monochromatic palette to create a primary focal point.
Vertical distress lines in the typography mirror the verticality of telephone poles in the background.
The subject's gaze is directed away from the camera, creating a sense of candid movement.
coreInvariants: High-grain film texture across the entire image.
Distressed, stencil-like or weathered typographic treatments.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left third, medium shot from waist up, slightly angled away.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red primary text spanning the horizontal center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze right, then drops to the bold red text and finally to the white secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample bright, textured space on the right side of the frame to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greyscale and muted blues (denim) for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for highlights and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson red for primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the red is the only high-chroma element.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, white, black, and grey

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses an italicized, heavy-weight sans-serif with eroded edges.
Secondary text uses a wide, bold slab-serif with a weathered stencil effect.
Vertical 'drip' or 'scratch' lines extend from the primary text characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Irregular, jagged outer strokes to simulate weathered paint
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a slanted, aggressive sans-serif with a stable, blocky slab-serif.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Headline with grunge filters
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and aggressive presence of the primary text.
Provides the blocky, grounded feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy, desaturated photo of a man in a dark denim jacket and baseball cap standing in a sun-bleached urban alley with telephone poles. Leave the right side of the frame relatively clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed red uppercase sans-serif text across the center. Add vertical paint-drip artifacts. Place a smaller, weathered white slab-serif text below and to the right of the red text.

verificationChecks: Is the red text the most saturated element?
Does the typography look weathered rather than clean?
Is the background sufficiently desaturated to make the subject and text pop?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the hat
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is legible despite distress.
Ensure the red text overlaps the subject naturally.
Check that the 'drips' don't obscure facial features.
Confirm the overall mood is Americana/Gritty.
recipe.reuseFormula: Desaturated Portrait + Distressed Red Display Type + Weathered White Slab Subtitle + Heavy Film Grain
